builder.language: python3 standard library only; no network, no subprocess
builder.reason: A legal ZIP with two same-named records cannot be produced by a writer that collapses duplicate names, so the records are written directly and then re-read with an independent standard-library reader.

verification.reader: python3 zipfile (independent of the builder code path)
verification.observed: all four records re-read, names in physical order stored.bin, deflated.bin, dup.bin, dup.bin; each payload matched byte for byte and each CRC and size matched

certificationObligations: The independent reader confirms the ordinal/method/original payload/CRC of all four physical entries; ordinal 2 and 3 share the name dup.bin and hold distinct payloads [1] and [2].
The duplicate name is neither collapsed nor silently chosen: the recipe binds every invocation by name plus ordinal, and the unselected-name invocation must reject with ambiguous_entry.
The output of the ambiguous call must not exist; no temp file may remain.
gaps: The extract seam and its publication behavior are application behavior not observable in this worktree; no file publisher is implemented here.
The ZIP CRC/entry projection is done with python3 zipfile only; a locked independent tool (TASKS 4.5) is B02/B03 work.
pathBase: case-root: every repository source path is relative to tests/e2e/sources/<case>/, and every generated artifact path is relative to the repository root under .cache/e2e/.
measurementPolicy: Asset sizes and hashes are produced by preparation from actual bytes under the ignored execution workspace; no author cache or hand-maintained measurement file is a prerequisite.
